description: Aanrijroutes Parkings Gent is a dataset listed in Open Data Portaal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Mobiliteitsbedrijf Gent. Deze dataset bevat een lijnenbestand met de aanrijroutes naar de parkings in de binnenstad van Gent. De dataset is afgeleid van de datalaag GBKwegsegmenten, die de lijnstukken tussen wegkruisingen bevat en ook beschikbaar is als open data. Coverage: Ghent. The portal files it under Mobiliteit. Its keywords are Parkeren. The portal shows 327 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-02-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Modellicentie Gratis Hergebruik (https://www.vlaanderen.be/digitaal-vlaanderen/onze-oplossingen/open-data/voorwaarden-voor-het-hergebruik-van-overheidsinformatie/modellicentie-gratis-hergebruik). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-stad-gent-portal.
